notes.title: 1.0.3 More bugfixes and improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Added[/h1]
 - compass
 - coordinates are visible on the screen after unlocking the compass
 - new "play" menu with save statistics and option to reset world
 - mouse controls
[h3]New items[/h3]
 - wooden compass

[h1]Improved[/h1]
 - Mining, changing direction and placing can now be control by mouse

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
 - [b]LADDER DROP GLITCH[/b]
 - Fix random creeper crashes (caused by doors)
 - Fix creeper bomb duplication in caves
 - Fix max scroll bug

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
 - Alt-tabbing texture issue
 - Alt-tabbing on menu crash
 - Game was unable to run on Windows 11 computers with local characters in Windows username

notes.title: Update 0.9.0
notes.content:
[h1]Added[/h1]
- Bombs
- Upgradable furniture
- Music
- Credits
[h3]New Items:[/h3]
- Copper doors
- Copper table
- Copper chair
- Copper chest
- Bomb
- Cart

[h1]Improved[/h1]
- Glyphs for PlayStation gamepads in tutorial
- Support for all PlayStation controllers
- Add WSAD+spacebar alternative controls
- Font in the English language
- Version number on the main menu
- Item list is now a rounded rectangle
- Player has random chance for blinking animation

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
- Explosions now destroy entities, dropped items and other data types
- Item list can't be "overscrolled"
- Fade transition on world loading
- Items can be unlocked by picking up from the ground

notes.title: Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
[h1]Added[/h1]
- Modloader
- Power system and powerable blocks
- PlayStation controllers support
[h3]New Items:[/h3]
- Rails
- Cart
[h3]Power System:[/h3]
- Some blocks can now be powered by connecting them to other powered blocks
- Furnace can now generate power when used
[h3]Rails:[/h3]
- Powered rails can move cart in the appropriate direction 5 times per second
- Cart can be used to transport player to any place on the map without keyboard input
[h3]Modloader:[/h3]
A special mod format was created to allow the community to write their owns items, drops, and recipes with custom textures, descriptions, and flags.  
[h1]Improved[/h1]
- Loading times (by loading world files async)
- FPS on item list view (by smart rendering)
- Obtaining items with full inventory (now they drop next to the player instead of "full inventory" popup)

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
- Furnace rendering bug
- Restarting the game was necessary to reconnect the controller
- Typo in "Nowy przedmot"
- All growing progress bars and indicators were visible after switching to another dimension
- Plants only grew in one dimension at the time
- Pause menu didn't pause the game
- Placing blocks when clicking save in pause menu bug
- Composted items obtained with full inventory were destroyed (now they will drop next to the player)
- Crafting recipe for lantern
